zh: 两个串长度都不超过 20，可以直接回溯：从模式的第一个字符和文本的开头出发，逐个决定每个模式字符对应哪一段文本。
需要两张表：字符到字符串的映射，以及已被占用的字符串集合（保证不同字符不会映射到同一个串）。已经有映射的字符只需检查文本在当前位置是否以该串开头。
递归状态为（模式位置 i，文本位置 j）：i 到达末尾时，当且仅当 j 也到达末尾才算成功；剩余文本比剩余模式字符还少时剪枝。当前字符已有映射就验证后跳过；否则枚举从 j 开始的每个非空前缀（给后面每个模式字符至少留一个字母），跳过已被占用的串，记录映射后递归，失败就撤销。能匹配输出 1，否则输出 0。
en: Both strings have length at most 20, so plain backtracking works: start at the first pattern character and the start of the text, and decide which piece of text each pattern character maps to.

Keep two tables: the mapping from characters to strings, and the set of strings already taken, so that different characters never share a string. For a character that is already mapped, just check that the text continues with that string at the current position.

The recursion state is (pattern position i, text position j): when i reaches the end, succeed exactly when j is also at the end, and prune when fewer text letters remain than pattern characters. If the current character is mapped, verify and move on; otherwise try every non-empty prefix starting at j that leaves at least one letter for each later pattern character, skip strings already taken, record the mapping, recurse, and undo it on failure. Print 1 if a match exists and 0 otherwise.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Backtrack over positions in the pattern and the text. If a mapping already exists, only verify that fixed string; otherwise enumerate every non-empty prefix at the current position, skip strings already taken by other characters, and recurse.

## Correctness

In a valid mapping, the current character's string is either already fixed or must be a non-empty prefix of the unconsumed text. Enumerating all such prefixes misses no solution, and the reverse set rejects many-to-one mappings; the match is complete when both strings end at the same time, and every other way of terminating is invalid.

## Complexity

Time O(|s|²·2^|s|) as a conservative upper bound, space O(|s|+|pattern|), with full lengths at most 20.
